nodes.title: Name claim
nodes.description:
A contributor, publication inference, or import asserts a localized name.

```ts
type NameClaim = { value: string; language: string; gender: GrammaticalGender | null }
```

nodes.title: Name claim evaluation
nodes.description: A reviewer records an evaluation against a name claim.

nodes.title: Consolidate names
nodes.description: Group equivalent spellings by language and place. Preserve display spelling and provenance.

nodes.title: Names by article
nodes.description: Localized names with their sources and contexts.

nodes.title: Build article paths
nodes.description: Derive one canonical path and alternate paths from names and resolved identifiers. Collapse duplicate paths.

nodes.title: Articles by path
nodes.description:
Resolve a canonical path or an alias to its article.

```ts
type ArticlesByPath = Record<string, { articleId: ArticleId; canonical: boolean }>
```

nodes.title: GBIF taxon ID claim
nodes.description: A contributor proposes an identifier, or a provider supplies a candidate ID.

nodes.title: Wikidata record
nodes.description: A Wikidata response can supply a GBIF taxon ID candidate.

nodes.title: Decide GBIF taxon ID
nodes.description:
Order of preference:
- an **EVALUATED** ID sent by a contributor
- Wikidata
- an **UNDECIDED** ID sent by a contributor

Confidence (or better word) is included in the GbifIdByArticle so that we can display it in the front-end (i.e. "This source has not yet been evaluated")

nodes.title: ArticlesByGbifId
nodes.description:
The selected GBIF identifier for a plant or animal article.

```ts
type ArticlesByGbifId = Record<
  GbifId, 
  { articleId: ArticleId, confidence: "UNVERIFIED" | "VERIFIED" | "EXTERNAL" }
>
```

@todo Looking for a better name than "confidence" and better values for it

nodes.title: GBIF result
nodes.description: An external fetch delivered a result tagged with its GBIF taxon ID.

nodes.title: Parse GBIF result
nodes.description:
Match the result to the resolved taxon ID and project taxonomy and occurrences.

Include the Confidence of the ID.

nodes.title: Taxonomy by article
nodes.description: The group and classification reported by GBIF for the selected taxon.

nodes.title: Occurrences by article
nodes.description: Occurrence records associated with the resolved taxon. This is a proposed output from the notebook.

nodes.title: Height observation
nodes.description: A person, inference, or Syntropedia provides a height range. Bounds are optional and ordered when both exist.

nodes.title: Summarize height
nodes.description: Summarize observed bounds in centimeters. Keep cultivar observations and parent bounds alongside each other with their origins.

nodes.title: Height by article
nodes.description: A situated height summary in centimeters, with a separate parent range for a cultivar.

nodes.title: Assemble article
nodes.description: Combine resolved properties into a consistent article projection for downstream readers.

nodes.title: Article document
nodes.description: Article page data assembled from supported properties.
